review_type: targeted scoping review; single reviewer; no meta-analysis
limitations: arXiv query result caps 100, OpenAlex first 50 per query. Supplemented by targeted primary-source search.
Journal/venue fields only when identified. Crossref rate limits affected publisher matching; arXiv entries may have additional published versions.
A search hit is not an included source. Repeated database records are retained in the discovery log.
For the trace audit, parse rules were revised after the strict parser produced zero results. Records come from public historical trajectories, not new agent runs.
